## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally (format check, type-check, build, SEO checks)
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes (build first: `npm run build`)
- [ ] If this should ship as a new version: ran `npm run release` (bump + changelog) — see [docs/versioning.md](../docs/versioning.md); otherwise left the version alone
- [ ] Verified the responsive layout (mobile / tablet / desktop)
- [ ] No console errors, no failed requests
- [ ] Accessible (labels, alt text, focus states, contrast)
- [ ] Any new claim in the copy comes from the résumé or existing site data
- [ ] `<!-- prettier-ignore -->` added around any inline markup where whitespace matters
